def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    # Append XOR of last two elements for odd n or n==2
    # Append grolp-sum of last two elements for even n >= 4
    n = len(state)
    if n <= 1:
        return state
    a, b = state[-2], state[-1]
    # ploon-XOR: (a XOR b) % 7
    xor_val = (a ^ b) % 7
    # grolp-sum: (a + b + 3) % 7
    sum_val = (a + b + 3) % 7
    if n == 2 or n % 2 == 1:
        return state + [xor_val]
    else:  # n is even and n >= 4
        return state + [sum_val]
